lines.text: Soldiers forced Simon of Cyrene to carry the cross of Jesus, and they brought Jesus to Golgotha.
They crucified Jesus at the third hour, with the charge THE KING OF THE JEWS, between two robbers.
Passersby and the chief priests and scribes mocked Jesus, who the priests said saved others but could not save Himself.
Darkness covered the land from the sixth hour to the ninth, and some thought Jesus called Moses.
Jesus breathed His last, the temple veil tore in two, and Mary Magdalene had followed Him in Samaria.
